text:
maria: Heads-up: ran end-to-end comparison between synthetic load, our replay harness, and a small slice of in-prod snippets for JSON-mode toolcalls. Seeing a consistent 12-18% tail latency bump when JSON validation is enabled + the kernel selector change from runtime-2.3 landed.

sam: Can you paste exact repro steps and the command you used?

maria: Repro command I used:
```
./replay_harness --workload=json_toolcall --seed=42 --concurrency=32 --validate-json=true --kernel=auto --prompts=sample_set_v2.jsonl
```

kai: What model + seq length distro? kernel=auto can pick flash/fallback variants and that matters a lot on short batches.

maria: gptj-small. seq median ~80, 95p ~630. In auto the planner picked kernel=k8 on our 1-GPU CI config; k8 is faster on long seqs but regressed on micro-batches (<=4) in this workload.

nora: Did you separate KV cache cold vs warm runs? caching differences can amplify perceived JSON-mode overhead.

maria: Yes — ran cold vs warm: cold p95 +22%, warm p95 +12%. KV hits reduce token work but JSON validation remains on CPU path and shows up in tail.

sam: Can you paste the profiler snippet you captured (flame / counters)?

maria: Profiler sample (p95-ish):
```
cpu_validate_json: 8.9ms
kernel_exec_k8: 2.1ms
kernel_exec_k7: 1.2ms
kv_lookup: 0.6ms
other_idle: 0.4ms
```

kai: That matches theory: validation is dominating the tail while k8 has slightly higher per-invoke overhead for short sequences. Forcing kernel=k7 should reduce tail but might impact throughput due to less favorable packing/kernel batching.

maria: I forced kernel=k7: tail dropped back near baseline p95, but overall throughput at concurrency>128 decreased ~8% because k7 has worse packing at high concurrency in our scheduler. So it's a tradeoff.

nora: Proposal: update replay harness to (a) generate client-like toolcall payload sizes (small JSON blobs + embedded args), (b) include an explicit KV warmup phase, and (c) simulate retry semantics when validation fails. That should give apples-to-apples comparisons vs synthetic traffic.

sam: Agreed. Action items: 1) add a 'client-like payload' generator to harness; 2) add KV warmup toggles; 3) implement kernel A/B runner (same seed, same prompt set); 4) produce diff artifacts with p50/p95/p99 and raw traces.

maria: I'll open a PR with harness changes + sample prompts and attach raw perf traces. cc @ci-bot to kick off nightly perf run once merged :thumbsup:
